subject: Pitch — Asia's glacial-flood risk and hydropower exposure (time-sensitive)
body:
Hi Amanda,

I'm writing from Talaix (talaix.com), a climate-extreme intelligence platform built on satellite Earth observation and open data — every finding labelled by evidence class, no invented numbers.

A pitch for your Asia Pacific beat, squarely on the Himalayan Watershed: after the Nepal–Tibet glacier-collapse flood of 31 August — 903 people killed and thousands missing, with a lake formed by the disaster now overflowing into Nepal's rivers — a regionally grounded story on what satellite data reveals about the exposure of Asia's hydropower and mountain communities to glacial-lake outburst floods.

What we can contribute: exposure mapping of at-risk hydropower sites and settlements, terrain and flow-path context, and historical comparison — every layer with its source and resolution stated, delivered as publication-ready maps and graphics. The reporting voice stays with your team or a local contributor; we bring the data and an expert perspective.

Why me: I operate an evidence-labelled climate-risk platform whose reports serve financial and public decision-makers — so the piece can also show readers how to separate measured fact from model output in disaster coverage.

Happy to send a short outline with the specific regions we can cover, or to scope it together.

Best,
Motaz OMARIEN. Talaix
Earth Observation & Environmental Risk
Financial Decision Intelligence
Luxembourg-based technology team
info@talaix.com | talaix.com
